reviews.text:
We contacted Carine for our little Golden Retriever's assessment and we're thrilled! 🐶❤️ She's very gentle, attentive, and caring, both with our dog and with us. She gave us lots of great advice to get this wonderful adventure off to a good start and even keeps in touch to follow her progress.

A passionate and truly lovely trainer whom we wholeheartedly recommend! 😊

Carine is working with our cocker spaniel to help us have a well-adjusted dog 🐾
The assessment she conducts is thorough, and Carine finds solutions and exercises that are easy to replicate.
She is available and professional; it's a pleasure to have sessions with her.
I went to Carine for my dog. She's patient, attentive, and gives great advice. I saw the difference very quickly! I highly recommend her.

Hello Sir,

I am quite surprised by this review, as after checking, I cannot find any client with your name and therefore do not believe I had the opportunity to assist you with your dog.

If we have nevertheless been in contact, please feel free to specify the context so that I can understand your feedback.

Otherwise, it may simply be a mistake or a confusion with another professional.

Sincerely,
Carine - Carinaduflair

Contacted Carina for problems with handling and socializing with my dog. There are several sessions that program the situation very much. Ahora is more sociable and more educated. Carina also taught me my language and gave me tips to communicate with my little ones and have a better relationship with them. Moreover, after a while, my baby got sick and she told me how to follow a good education and learn with her best physics. So we can't recommend it more! ;)

I can recommend Carina with my eyes closed!

I contacted her about my puppy's anxiety and socialization issues. After our sessions together, the situation improved significantly. Today, he is much more sociable and far better behaved.

Carina also helped me better understand his natural communication and gave me lots of tips for communicating with him more effectively. Thanks to this, our relationship has become more harmonious and stronger.

A few weeks after our sessions ended, my little one unfortunately had some health problems. Even during this difficult time, Carina continued to advise and support me, explaining how to continue his training while respecting his physical condition and supporting his recovery.

Her professionalism, kindness, and dedication go far beyond simple dog training classes. I couldn't recommend her highly enough! 😊

You can trust Carine completely. I needed help with my 3-year-old poodle who was completely emotionally disturbed following recent events over the past year. I was utterly desperate, but she understood the various issues and resolved our problems in record time. Once again, a thousand thanks (and a thousand kisses from Simon).

Carine worked for several weeks with Helios and Kalipso, our two young Labradors, to resolve some minor behavioral issues. She is extremely professional, very patient and patient, flexible, and, to top it all off, lovely.

Not only does she make accurate diagnoses, but she also has the expertise to solve problems and, most importantly, gives us, the human parents, advice on a number of points. We were delighted to meet her and I highly recommend her.

We needed help with our first dog, a little English Cocker Spaniel, and we were lucky enough to meet Carina.

Her support is simply fantastic. She starts with a very thorough behavioral assessment, which allows her to understand our dog in depth, as well as our habits and lifestyle.

We then had our first training session and a session at the dog park. Carina is an exceptional trainer—attentive, caring, and very professional. She truly takes the time to understand our concerns, our fears, and above all, our dog.

We plan to continue the sessions in the coming months and are already seeing real progress.

And very importantly: Carina doesn't abandon us after the sessions. She remains available to answer our questions, reassure us, and offer advice.

I recommend Carina without hesitation!

I was fortunate enough to have Carine as my dog's trainer, and I highly recommend her. She is gentle, caring, and a good listener, and she offers original exercises that truly make a difference. Very attentive, she helped us progress and build a wonderful relationship with my pet. Thank you again!

Carine was a huge help when I adopted Frankie. She helped me with welcoming the puppy, what behavior and habits to adopt, what equipment to buy—in short, so many questions that you often don't have answers to at first. Later, she continued to work with Frankie because she was overreacting to children and balls, which caused problems on walks. But with a gentle approach, reinforcing positive behaviors and (lots of) patience, we did a fantastic job together! Today, Frankie can live her best life without her mom stressing out on the street. So thank you again 😊
